kjv: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me. Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.

lines.say: Afraid of the dark tonight? Hear this.

lines.say: The dark doesn't hide anything from him, and it doesn't hide you either.

lines.say: Lord, the darkness is light to you. Watch over me tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.
